key_insight: AISPA introduces a user-centric way to audit the hidden system prompts that shape large language model behavior in real-world AI products. It helps make prompt-driven model behavior more transparent, accountable, and easier to evaluate.
problem_solved: Commercial AI applications often rely on system prompts that are not publicly disclosed, leaving users and regulators unable to understand or verify how model behavior is controlled. This creates a trust and accountability gap in deployed AI systems.
method: Defines a structured framework, Artificial Intelligence System Prompt Assurance (AISPA), for auditing system prompts from the user perspective.
Systematically examines prompt characteristics and their effects on model behavior in AI applications.
Provides a practical basis for evaluating whether hidden instructions align with expected, safe, and transparent system behavior.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, AISPA offers a path toward better governance, debugging, and compliance for prompt-based applications. It can improve transparency and reduce the risks of undisclosed prompt manipulation in deployed systems.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram showing user request -> hidden system prompt -> model behavior -> audit findings
Side-by-side comparison of transparent vs. opaque AI application workflows
Checklist or scorecard icon set for prompt auditing criteria
Trust gap illustration showing users, developers, and regulators on different sides of hidden prompts
paper_title: AISPA: User-Centric System Prompt Auditing for Large Language Model Applications
paper_authors: Xiangning Lin, Shenzhe Zhu, Shu Yang, Zhenyu Zhang, Haoqian Zhang
